items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: We liked King Oliver and we liked Jelly Roll Morton

ctx.x: You anticipated my next question. Were you kind of a club of one?

No. As a matter of fact we had a rhythm club, and I was eleven years old at the time, and I can remember asking someone just quite recently when Bobby and I were up in the north of England. I said, “Tell me, what was I like when I was eleven?” And this woman said, “You were a cheeky little monkey.” I wanted to know everything. For instance we were very square, as jazz fans, and we liked the older type music. We liked King Oliver and we liked Jelly Roll Morton, and I didn’t subscribe to the idea of anyone needing…
Were records harder to get in the north of England at the time?
